logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the complexes was determined using the flask-shaking method and represented by the partition coefficient (log Po/w) between n-octanol and water.23 For the assessment, 0.001 g of each complex was mixed with a 10 mL solution of n-octanol and water (1 : 1 v/v) at 298 K. The concentration of the complex in each phase was quantified based on the Beer– Lambert law, and the lipophilicity was calculated using formula (3)
